lines.text: High above the valley stands a temple... and in it, a monk who commands every stone.
Moros. The Shard Monk.
He tears the courtyard apart, and shapes it into weapons. An executioner's axe.
But Kaito, the Blade Hand, answers stone with stone.
A serpent dragon... shattered by a single punch.
A titan's hand closes around him. Thunder Palm blasts it apart.
A storm of stone lances.
A bird of stone, diving from the sky.
The Skybreaker.
And a flood of rock.
When Kaito runs, Moros hunts. Serpents of stone sweep the streets.
Up on the rooftops, the swarms cannot see him.
Until he comes down.
Thunder Palm. Every swarm, shattered.
Wounded, the monk arms himself. The temple becomes an arsenal.
Gatling guns of stone.
Homing rockets. Kaito takes to the walls.
And a siege cannon, raining down on the rooftops.
There is nowhere to hide. Indoors, the stones become a storm.
A storm that drags him back out.
Seeker swarms hunt him, room by room.
Then... the Blade Hand awakens.
Moros answers with a dragon the size of a street.
Broken, and furious, the monk calls every stone in the temple.
Stone by stone, he becomes the Living Temple.
A titan that walks, while it is still being born.
One last stance. Kaito calls his guardian.
And the temple... falls silent.
Last Stance.
